assumptions.impact: The simplification will make active controller state, manual-clear outcome, and historical observation visibly distinct without claiming the existing backend failed.
assumptions.rollback: If a physical-device probe shows that the public simulation proxy remains active after a successful clear, track and fix that backend defect separately before accepting the simplification.
assumptions.statement: Treat the address still shown by the iOS app as retained observation or selection UI, not as proof that the Xcode simulation proxy is still active.

assumptions.impact: The cleanup refactor will avoid reverting unrelated in-progress connectivity work, even when it overlaps the same files.
assumptions.rollback: The user can explicitly authorize superseding particular overlapping edits after reviewing the diff.
assumptions.statement: Preserve and build around the existing uncommitted Controller Link and UI edits.

decisions.choice: Use a manually started, test-session-scoped Mac Controller process and remove the always-running LaunchAgent lifecycle.
decisions.rationale: The user does not want Pinshift to leave a persistent process in macOS and is willing to start the controller when testing.

decisions.choice: Keep automatic clear as a fixed, non-configurable three-minute behavior for trial use.
decisions.rationale: The user wants to try a hard-coded three-minute default and evaluate whether it matches the expected workflow.

decisions.choice: If the Controller exits normally before the three-minute deadline, execute one real backend Clear and report success or failure before process exit.
decisions.rationale: This preserves session-scoped process ownership without leaving an active simulation behind merely because the test session ended early.

commitment.presentation_note: User approved fixed three-minute Automatic Clear and real Clear before early normal Controller exit; revised contract validated.

fragments.content: iOS app 在超时时间后仍然显示模拟地址；怀疑 macOS 常驻服务没有实际价值。希望大幅简化当前实现，砍掉这块，并在 iOS 提供手动清理按钮，通过后端执行清理。用户原句末尾不完整。
测试时手动启动 Mac Controller；不要常驻进程污染 macOS。手动 Clear 必须真实生效，当前无法清理时只能重启手机，造成很大麻烦。
保留默认自动清理，但把时间直接写死为三分钟，先试用这个行为是否符合预期。
如果 Controller 在三分钟期限前正常退出，退出前立即执行一次真实 Clear；成功或明确报告失败后再退出。

constraints: Manual clear still requires a reachable Mac, Xcode devicectl, and the Active Test Device; the iOS app cannot perform this system operation alone.
A Clear success acknowledgement is valid only after the public devicectl clear command has actually succeeded; missing or stale controller bookkeeping must never produce a false success.
A successful backend clear does not guarantee an immediate fresh physical Core Location callback; historical observation must not be presented as active controller state.
Preserve existing uncommitted user changes and do not silently revert overlapping Controller Link or UI work.
Automatic Clear is fixed at exactly 180 seconds and is not user-configurable.
A normal Controller shutdown before the deadline must attempt one real backend Clear and must not hide a failure.
Reopening ADR-0010 is intentional: the new session-scoped lifecycle replaces its persistent authority and changes the fixed duration from 15 minutes to 3 minutes.
context: The user observed that the iOS app still shows the simulated address after the advertised timeout and no longer trusts the value of the automatic-cleanup service.
Current Mac persisted authority reports no active simulation, while the app deliberately retains selection and last-observation evidence.

Clear Now and the Controller Link clear command already exist; most complexity lies in automatic deadlines, persisted current state, retry reconciliation, countdown UI, and always-on runtime ownership.
The user chose a manually started test-session Controller and explicitly rejected an always-running LaunchAgent.
The current target-operation optimization can acknowledge a stale Clear as a no-op without executing devicectl, which is incompatible with the required reliable manual cleanup semantics.
The user subsequently retained Automatic Clear as a hard-coded three-minute trial behavior rather than removing it entirely.
The user decided that ending the Controller session early triggers one synchronous real Clear before normal process exit.

done_when.condition: Every successful Apply receives a fixed deadline exactly three minutes after acceptance, with no duration setting or extension path.
done_when.evidence: Focused domain, controller, protocol, and UI tests assert an immutable 180-second interval and repository search shows no configurable duration or legacy 15-minute product copy.

done_when.condition: The iOS app exposes a clear, usable manual Clear action and distinguishes active simulation, successful clear, failed clear, and historical observation.
done_when.evidence: View-model and UI tests exercise Apply then manual Clear success/failure, reject false acknowledgement, and verify that retained observation is not labeled as an active simulation.

done_when.condition: The Mac Controller runs only inside an explicitly started test session and leaves no Pinshift LaunchAgent or controller process after that session ends.
done_when.evidence: CLI/integration tests and process inspection verify foreground/session ownership, launchd absence, clean termination, and continued Apply/Clear execution through devicectl.

done_when.condition: Normal Controller shutdown before an active three-minute deadline performs one real Clear and reports any backend failure before exiting.
done_when.evidence: A deterministic signal/shutdown integration test arms a simulation, terminates the session early, requires one backend clear call, and asserts distinct success and failure exit results.

done_when.condition: Every accepted manual Clear invokes the Injection Backend even if local lifecycle state is idle, missing, or stale, and failure is reported honestly.
done_when.evidence: A red-capable controller regression test starts with mismatched or absent bookkeeping, requires one backend clear call, and distinguishes backend success from failure.

done_when.condition: Manual Clear is proven on the supported physical iPhone without relying on a fresh physical-location callback or phone reboot.
done_when.evidence: A physical-device checkpoint applies a simulated location, clears it from the iOS button, and independently verifies the public location simulation proxy is inactive; the direct Mac reset command remains a no-reboot recovery path when Controller Link is unavailable.

done_when.condition: Existing unrelated in-progress work remains intact.
done_when.evidence: Final diff review accounts for the pre-existing dirty files and shows no unintended reversions.

next_action.description: Add and run red-capable controller tests proving that Clear cannot acknowledge success without executing the backend and that early normal session shutdown invokes one real Clear before exit.

goal.outcome: Pinshift uses a substantially smaller cleanup flow: a Mac Controller runs only during an explicitly started test session, every Apply has one hard-coded three-minute Automatic Clear deadline, early normal Controller exit performs a real Clear, the iOS app can request a real backend Clear that never falsely acknowledges success, the persistent LaunchAgent and durable retry machinery are removed, and cleanup no longer requires rebooting the iPhone when the Mac and device are reachable.

Install or run changed software on the physical iPhone, invoke a live Apply/Clear, or alter signing and Keychain state.

in_scope: Replace the 15-minute lifecycle with one hard-coded three-minute Automatic Clear timer owned only by the running test-session Controller, while removing duration configuration, extensions, durable retry/backoff, and restart reconciliation.

Remove the Pinshift LaunchAgent, RunAtLoad/KeepAlive installation behavior, and background start semantics; make the Controller terminal-owned or otherwise scoped to the explicitly started test session.
Retain and simplify the existing iOS manual Clear action so every accepted request executes backend clear and directly reports its real acknowledgement or failure.
Handle normal Controller termination by performing one real Clear before exit when a simulation may still be active, with an explicit non-success result if backend clear fails.
Make active controller state and historical Selected/Observed Location visually unambiguous after clear.
Keep a direct Mac clear/reset command as a no-reboot recovery path when the iOS Controller Link is unavailable.
Provide a safe migration/removal path for obsolete automatic-cleanup state and LaunchAgent configuration.
out_of_scope: Adding an unsupported iOS-only system-location injection or clear mechanism.
Adding a cloud backend or supporting multiple Macs or device fleets.
Allowing the user to configure or extend the three-minute Automatic Clear duration.
Guaranteeing immediate physical-location callbacks after backend clear.
Changing Saved Location, map selection, or unrelated Controller Link peer-to-peer connectivity behavior.
